name: HIJAZ Hermes Skills Making Factory
description: Autonomous skills engineering ecosystem for creating, combining, testing, and improving reusable agent skills.
governance_rules: Never overwrite a working production skill with an untested experiment.
Never delete original repository content without authorization.
Never copy copyrighted or restricted code without respecting its license.
Never introduce secrets or credentials into skill files.
Never claim a skill is tested without actual test evidence.
Keep experimental and production libraries separate.
Use isolated testing environments where possible.
Require authorization for destructive repository operations and external publication.
Ensure every production skill has documentation and reproducible tests.
